mapper.sql: INSTRUMENTID, INSTRUMENTNO, INSTRUMENTTYPE, INSTRUMENTSTATUS, ISSUEDATE, MATURITYDATE, FACEAMOUNT, CURRENCYCODE, ISSUER, PAYEE, DRAWEE, ACCEPTOR, ISSUINGBANK, ACCEPTINGBANK, INSTRUMENTTERMS, BUSINESSPURPOSE, TRADEBACKGROUND, REMARK, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS NOT IN ('MATURED', 'CANCELLED') AND MATURITYDATE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY MATURITYDATE ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS NOT IN ('MATURED', 'CANCELLED') AND MATURITYDATE < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY MATURITYDATE ASC
SELECT INSTRUMENTTYPE as instrumentType, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY INSTRUMENTTYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT INSTRUMENTSTATUS as instrumentStatus, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY INSTRUMENTSTATUS ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ISSUER = #{issuer} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND PAYEE = #{payee} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ACCEPTINGBANK = #{acceptingBank} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS IN ('ISSUED', 'ACCEPTED') AND MATURITYDATE > CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY MATURITYDATE ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS IN ('ISSUED', 'ACCEPTED') AND MATURITYDATE > CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY MATURITYDATE ASC
SELECT CURRENCYCODE as currencyCode, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CURRENCYCODE ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT DATE(MATURITYDATE) as maturityDate, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount, GROUP_CONCAT(INSTRUMENTNO) as instrumentNos FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND MATURITYDATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS NOT IN ('MATURED', 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY DATE(MATURITYDATE) ORDER BY maturityDate ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN MATURITYDATE < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN DATEDIFF(MATURITYDATE, CURRENT_DATE) <= 7 THEN 'HIGH_RISK' WHEN DATEDIFF(MATURITYDATE, CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 THEN 'MEDIUM_RISK' ELSE 'LOW_RISK' END as riskLevel, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS NOT IN ('MATURED', 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY riskLevel ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(CREATETIME, '%Y-%m-%d') as period,
DATE_FORMAT(CREATETIME, '%Y-%u') as period,
DATE_FORMAT(CREATETIME, '%Y-%m') as period,
DATE_FORMAT(CREATETIME, '%Y') as period,
COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND DATE(CREATETIME) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period ASC

SELECT COALESCE(ACCEPTINGBANK, '未知银行') as bankName, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ACCEPTINGBANK IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACCEPTINGBANK ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT INSTRUMENTID as instrumentId, INSTRUMENTNO as instrumentNo, INSTRUMENTTYPE as instrumentType, FACEAMOUNT as faceAmount, MATURITYDATE as maturityDate, DATEDIFF(MATURITYDATE, CURRENT_DATE) as remainingDays,
'即将到期' as alertType
'已到期' as alertType
'风险预警' as alertType
FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}
AND MATURITYDATE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS NOT IN ('MATURED', 'CANCELLED')
AND MATURITYDATE < CURRENT_DATE AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS NOT IN ('MATURED', 'CANCELLED')
AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS NOT IN ('MATURED', 'CANCELLED')
ORDER BY MATURITYDATE ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'ISSUED' THEN FACEAMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as issuedAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'ACCEPTED' THEN FACEAMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as acceptedAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'DISCOUNTED' THEN FACEAMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as discountedAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN MATURITYDATE < CURRENT_DATE AND INSTRUMENTSTATUS NOT IN ('MATURED', 'CANCELLED') THEN FACEAMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as expiredAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}

SELECT i.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_ENDORSEMENT e WHERE e.INSTRUMENTID = i.INSTRUMENTID) as endorsementCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_DISCOUNT d WHERE d.INSTRUMENTID = i.INSTRUMENTID) as discountCount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO i WHERE i.INSTRUMENTID = #{instrumentId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 END) as draftCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'ISSUED' THEN 1 END) as issuedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 END) as acceptedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'ENDORSED' THEN 1 END) as endorsedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'DISCOUNTED' THEN 1 END) as discountedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'MATURED' THEN 1 END) as maturedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN INSTRUMENTSTATUS = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) as cancelledCount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}

SELECT MONTH(CREATETIME) as month, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND YEAR(CREATETIME) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(CREATETIME) ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT YEAR(CREATETIME) as year, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND YEAR(CREATETIME) BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} GROUP BY YEAR(CREATETIME) ORDER BY year ASC

SELECT
ISSUER as partnerName,
PAYEE as partnerName,
ACCEPTOR as partnerName,
ACCEPTINGBANK as partnerName,
COUNT(*) as count, SUM(FACEAMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM TBL_INSTRUMENT_BASIC_INFO WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND
ISSUER IS NOT NULL
PAYEE IS NOT NULL
ACCEPTOR IS NOT NULL
ACCEPTINGBANK IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY partnerName ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20
